title: isoetes tuckermanii var. heterospora

Research on this plant is limited, but it is believed to have potential health benefits, such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, due to its possible use in traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of Isoetes tuckermanii var. heterospora are not well-documented, but it is thought to have antimicrobial and wound-healing properties.
